cohort: 991,042 singleton infants born at or after 34 weeks gestation in Queensland, Australia between 2000 and 2018
finding: Although the incidence and risk of perinatal mortality, severe neurological morbidity and severe morbidity increased at the extremes of birthweight centiles, the majority of these outcomes occurred in infants that were apparently "appropriately grown" (i.e., birthweight 10th-90th centile).
